entries.differs: The config core reads the config files itself, so no fs.read reaches a port (omo-sdk/config/index.ts:21).

A send lists the endpoints as one offline view (host.list_sessions {offline: true}); all_scope widens which threads the address may resolve to, never the listing request, so no list_sessions {scope: "all"} is made (sdk-send.ts viewForSend).

No leg carries an attachment yet (the gateway delivery on this device and the relay record to another device have no field for one), so the root refuses the send unsupported before any effect instead of reading and delivering it (omo-sdk/root/threads.ts attachmentsRefused).
